_comment: Spec for scripts/deb-copyright.py: the DEP-5 copyright file that
scripts/tauri-notices.mjs writes for the Linux packages (deb, AppImage and
the Flatpak repacked from the deb). Paths are relative to this file; $VARS
come from the environment that script sets (toolchain paths and version).

components.name: Rust crates and web components
components.license_text: The Rust crates linked into the binary and the npm packages and fonts of its embedded web frontend keep their own licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, ISC, Unicode-3.0, Zlib, MPL-2.0, OFL-1.1 and others). Their full license texts, copyright notices and source links are in Third-Party-Notices.txt, next to this file.
copyright: The authors of each component, as listed in Third-Party-Notices.txt

components.name: Rust standard library
components.comment: The full notices, including those of the standard library's own dependencies, are in Rust-Licenses.html next to this file.
